from rest_framework.decorators import api_view, permission_classes
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.utils import timezone
from django_q.models import OrmQ, Task
from .models import RenderJob

@api_view(['POST'])
@permission_classes([IsAuthenticated])
def cancel_render_task(request, task_id):
    # Verify that the calling user owns the corresponding render job
    job = RenderJob.objects.filter(task_id=task_id, submitted_by=request.user).first()
    if not job:
        raise PermissionDenied("You do not own this rendering task")

    OrmQ.objects.filter(key=task_id).delete()
    Task.objects.filter(id=task_id).update(stopped=timezone.now())

    return Response({"task_id": task_id, "status": "evicted"})
